t: Mi shennizdammen lo tzoa bishat qeria
s: Mi shennizdammen lo tzoa bishat qeria ubo y"a seipim: hayeta tzoat adam meacharayv apillu en lah reach — tzarik leharchiq mimmenna d' ammot, shenneemar: "vehaya machaneka qadosh", umachanehu shel adam dehaynu chanayato — hayyanu d' ammot lekol ruach (shezzehu meqomo shel adam kesheyyishkob veyipshot yadayv veraglayv kemo sheyyitbaer siman shm"t), chutz mikkeneged panayv sheshsham iqqar chanayato. Vetzarik lihyot machanehu qadosh kimlo enayv. Vaapillu ballayla sheeno roeh otah, o shehu suma — tzarik leharchiq ad maqom shehappiqqeach lo yukal lirotah bayyom. Utzedadim shellepanayv — hare hem kilpanayv, veshelleacharayv — kilacharayv (utzedadin mammash — yitbaer besiman p"a):

Veim yesh lah reach — tzarik shello yihyeh rechah betok d' ammot shelleacharayv utzedadin, sheim lo ken — en machanehu qadosh. Lepikak tzarik leharchiq d' ammot mimmaqom shekkaleh hareach. Vaapillu im yesh lo choli sheeno meriach — tzarik leharchiq d' ammot mimmaqom shekkaleh hareach lemi shemmeriach (abal millepanayv en tzarik leharchiq melo enayv mimmaqom shekkaleh hareach, ella kevan sheeno yakol lirotah — hare machanehu qadosh):

Sheliach tzibbur hammitpalel vetzoa bebet hakkeneset o beezeh bayit shemmitpalel sham, apillu hu leacharayv bekol habbayit — tzarik hu lishtoq ad sheyyotziuhu, meachar shemmotzi rabbim yede chobatan vei epshar shello yihyeh echad min haqqahal betok d' ammot mimmaqom shekkaleh hareach, vei epshar lo lekavven ulishmoa mehashsheliach tzibbur, veen hashshaliach tzibbur motzio yede chobato ella im ken shomea mimmennu. Veim hu bipsuqe dezimra sheeno motzi acherim yede chobatan — muttar lashsheliach tzibbur lomar kedarko im hu chutz ld' ammot. Ubeme raglayim sheen lahem reach — yekolim kol haqqahal leharchiq d' ammot, veyakol hashsheliach tzibbur lomar kedarko bekol inyan:

Hayeta bemaqom gaboah y' tepachim o namuk y' tepachim — hare zeh reshut leatzmo veniqra machanehu qadosh, ap al pi sheyyosheb betziddah veroeh otah veqore. Vehu sheen rechah maggia elayv. Veyesh omerim shetztzarik sheyyihyeh rochab maqom hahu d' tepachim al d' tepachim veaz hu maqom chashub lachaloq reshut leatzmo kemo bareshuyyot shel shabbat. Veyesh lachush ledibrehem lehachamir beshel tora:

Veken im hayeta becheder echad vehu qore becheder acher, apillu happetach patuach benehem vehu yosheb etzel happetach besamuk lah veroeh otah — muttar im en rechah maggia elayv, lepi shehappetach hi kesatum, kevan sheyyesh lah gippupim mikkan umikkan hammabdilim ben cheder lecheder. Veyesh mi sheoser mi sheroeh otah ap al pi shehi birshut acheret. Vehaiqqar kisbara harishona, shekkevan shehi birshut acheret ap al pi sheroeh otah — hare zeh ketzoa baashashit sheen issur kelal biriyyatah. Veap al pi ken tob lachush lidbarayv. Veim maatzim enayv o ballayla — muttar bazeh ledibre hakkol, kevan shehi birshut acheret vegam eno roeh otah:

Im heebiru tzoa babbayit venishar adayin reach ra babbayit — yesh lehachamir shello liqrot bo ad sheyyikleh hareach, ap al pi shehatztzoa kebar cholpa veobra. Umikkol maqom mi sheeno meriach — muttar liqrot bazeh, kevan sheen tzoa babbayit:

Chatzer qetanna shennipretza bemilluah laggedolla ubaggedola yesh gippupim haodepim al happirtza mikkan umikkan — haqqetanna enah chashuba kebayit bipne atzmah ella hu keqeren zavit shel haggedola hoil venipretza lah bemilluah, vehaggedola hi kebayit bipne atzmah hoil venishtayyeru bah gippupim mikkan umikkan. Lepikak im tzoa baggedola — asur liqrot baqqetanna (ad sheyyarchiq keshiur), abal im tzoa baqqetanna — muttar liqrot baggedola belo harchaqa, kevan shehu kebayit bipne atzmo, raq shello yihyeh rechah maggia elayv, vegam shello yirenna ledibre haoserim leel saip h' (bammeh debarim amurim? Keshekkotle orek haqqetanna niknasim letok haggedola umuplagim sham g' tepachim mikkotle orek haggedola, sheim lo ken ap haqqetanna hi kebayit bipne atzmah al yede gippupe haggedola, mishshum nireh mibbachutz veshaveh mibbipnim, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman sh"s):

Tzoat keleb o chazir, im natan bahem orot — marchiq mehem kemo mitztzoat adam. Veim lav — dinan kemo tzoat shear behema chayya vaop, sheen tzarik lehitracheq mehem kelal im en bahem reach. Veim yesh bahem reach — en tzarik leharchiq ella ad sheyyikleh hareach velo yoter. Chutz mitztzoa rakka shel chamor habba min hadderek umitztzoat chatul unemiyya shehen ketzoat adam, lepi shessetaman rechan ra. Velaken apillu yizdammen paam achat sheen lahem reach — aseru ketzoat adam. Veim yesh lahem reach — tzarik leharchiq d' ammot mimmaqom sheyyikleh hareach. Veken haddin binbela masrachat. Umikkol maqom haholek badderek ap al pi sheroeh tzoat behema kenegdo, im en hareach ba lo — eno choshesh lammiut litlotah beshel chamor. Abal besamuk lair — yesh omerim sheyyesh lachush, lepi sherob behemot hammetzuyim sham hem chamorim, bammeqomot shehachamorim metzuyim:

Yesh oserin liqrot keneged me ragle chamor habba min hadderek ukeneged tzoat tarnegolim adummim (sheqqorin angly"shn ha"n bilshon ashkenaz o ayndy"q), shettarnegolin ellu tzoatan masrachat meod (velaken hi ketzoat adam, sheap al pi sheyyizdammen sheen lah reach ra — asur. Veim yesh lah reach — tzarik leharchiq d' ammot mimmaqom shekkaleh hareach, kemo betzoat adam velo ketzoat shear opot sheyyesh lahen reach). Abal tzoat shear tarnegolim haholekim babbayit — dino kedin tzoat shear opot. Abal hallul shellahem yesh bo sirchon larob, velaken dino ketzoat adam:

Asur liqrot qeriat shema keneged ashpa sherechah ra (apillu en hareach mitztzoa megulla shealeha ella mehattemuna umekussa), o mitztzoa shecholpa veobra venishar rechah sham (vehu shehareach maggia elayv):

Reach ra sheen lo iqqar, kegon sheyyatza mimmennu ruach millematta — gazeru alayv chakamim mishshum reach ra sheyyesh lo iqqar, veasur bedibre tora ad sheyyikleh hareach, veen tzarik leharchiq kelum. Veim yatza mechabero — muttar bedibre tora, mippene shehu dabar shei epshar lizzaher mimmennu, shehattalmidim shebbebet hammidrash qetzatam goresim ballayla uqetzatam yeshenim umepichim betok hashshena, lepikak lo gazeru al shel chabero ledibre tora. Velaken apillu im lomed beyachid veepshar lo latzet lemaqom acher — eno tzarik latzet, kevan shello gazeru al zeh kelal ledibre tora. Abal liqrot qeriat shema (o lehitpallel) gazeru apillu al shel chabero ad sheyyikleh hareach, kevan shelleolam epshar lo lelek lemaqom acher liqrot o lehitpallel sham:
